title: MV METALOVEMANIA - The RPG Where You Fight with the power of Music and Friendship

posts.author: Beelxiii
posts.body:
Fenix Fendales goes to the city to pursue her dreams of being a work ready musician. However, strange things keep happening to the reformed punky brewster, ghosts, manic people, yakuza, and even the military want a piece of her, but all she wants is a piece of paper.
Join Fenix Fendales on her modern odyssey in —
​
The Setting of Metalovemania
Metalovemania takes place in an an alternate timeline where the early 2000s never ended. A mega corporation had solved a major crisis and saved what was once called the USA. Fenix is introduced as one of the many new adults navigating this version of the world.

About 6 years ago I was disillusioned about video games. I got older didnt like a lot of the games that were out at the time. Someone came up to me and said something that put me on game making. "If you don't like this game and the ending, Make your own." I thought about all the games I did like and began making Metalomania. Along the way I started appreciating games again and even got a new perspective on old ones too. So, if you like Persona 3-5, dating sims, The Urbz, RPG Maker games, indie games Sonic Adventure Battle 2, and, hell even Earthbound, you're home, pal
SYNOPSIS Hold On to Your Butts
Spoiler
Fenix goes to the city and rooms with her childhood friend. On the days before she starts her term, Fenix reunites her childhood friend with her middle school
friends. Along the way, they have adventures in and out of table top fighting ghost, weirdos, and the yakuza down the street.
Fenix starts her semester but feels out of place since she was practically the only person who wasn't from a super polished background. Luckily, a girl she met earlier introduces her to a group of students that don't exactly fit in. Fenix starts to get used to her college life and helps her new friends along the way.
Though all is not well as one student seems to be dragging down the group. When one of her schoolmates is not showing up for cheer practice, Fenix teams up with her school friends to find her.
At this point, Fenix is comfortable with her new friends and college life, but it comes to a halt when the Dean is screen cowering near the campus gates. The university was lost in a poker match with other billionaires. Stephanie knows where the deed is and organizes a heist to grab it.
After the heist Fenix tries to resume her college life.  But her friends are divided on if they should keep her around. Fenix runs away and takes a train to a random local. She ends up in a punk town where she meets people like her. A band of misunderstood punks. As she was getting settled with them, the punk town was invaded by the military.
Fenix groups up with the punks to fight them.
This act gets Fenix in trouble with a lot of adults and grabs the attention of a televangelist. Fenix confronts the bishop and visits him regularly to keep his followers from harassing her. Eventually, she ran from her apartment and rushed to the one safe place. The cathedral near her school. The bishop helped Fenix one last time.
Fenix is offers to see a concert at the mall by her girlfriends, but they get their early. They kill some time until night time. The show starts but sometimes was off. Fenix meets the boy-band members and ends up in the middle of a pop music military conscription conspiracy.
A day after, the CEO offers a bribe, but she refuses. Right at the bus stop waiting for her where the boy-band. They take her against her will and get trapped in their own penthouse with her.
Fenix is able to leave the penthouse and is led to an important meeting that was being held next to the lawyer's office. The lawyer tells Fenix what she must do and to stop the major plot, causing a countdown of days until Battle of the Bands.

Gameplay
Spoiler
No XP, No Problem
While a lot of games, especially RPGs, have a leveling system, this one doesn't. I wanted to make something less grindy.
Fashion based stat progression
There's still armor and weapon in the game, but it takes the form of Fashion, Charms, and Instruments. You can customize your stats based to the outfits and instruments you buy.
Socializing
You can interact with certain characters. Chat, Gift, and even Hangout with them. Who knows maybe you can learn more about them or take it further.
Part-time gigs
You still need money in this world, and there a few ways to get it.
Get a job!
As you progress in the story, Fenix has to make at lest 150 bucks a month to keep her side of the rent or it's game over for you and her. You can play Part-time job mini games to keep her a float.

The Main Girl
Spoiler
Fenix Fandales
Fenix is a bit of a mixed bag compared to her peers. On one hand she has odd colored hair and dark clothings, on the other she was pretty soft hearted and witty. But because of her appearance she just comes off as... a punk, a goth, a cultist, a freak, you name it, she got called it at least once. But lucky for Fenix she was just about to graduate from highschool and won a raffle for free tuition for the best college in Homeland. She packs her bags, argued with her parents and leaves for Emperia Major.
Friends and Lovers
Spoiler
Becky Nolls
Becky is your childhood friend from when you used to live in the city. You reunited with her thanks to Basebook and started catching up with her. She's owns a lot of anime stuff, but I still wonder how she makes the money for it.
Archie Angelo (Bachelor?)
Whether it be to open a door for someone or to give the hoodie off his back, he will do it for only m'lady. What a nice guy.
Devin D'vil (Batchelor?)
Burned, scorned, jaded, you name it, he feels it. Devin is someone who has no time for playing games and only wants to focus on himself. No woman, no cry.
Stephanie De La'Vega
Dressed in an all pink uniform and a smile, you would think she's an airhead, but you hear her talk, and you realize she's a hyper geek for the music industry.
Niles Braxton (Bachelor)
The heir to a massive weapons manufacturing company it's all he's really known for and he knows this. There's just gloomy feel around him due to this.
Serena Bellethorn
Gifted, beautiful, and elusive are the words that are usually said about her. Serena is a vocal prodigy who was born from a famous opera singer. Although she's a really good singer, nobody would really recognize her outside of the opera scene.
Kairon Kareem (Bachelor)
Is a charmer and a musician at heart. He loved to flirt with girls and will go so far as to have multiple under his spell at the same time. There's a lot of mystery about him. When asked about his background, parentage, or fortunate he rather keep it under wraps.
Ace (Bachelor)
A lot of people might see Ace and call him a punk. They would be half right. Ace is someone who doesn't like conforming but wants everyone to get along.
Null (Bachelor)
Is an emo guy, surfs the web a lot, doesn't say much. Eats junk food and always shuts down after a break up.
Growly (Bachelor)
A burly metal head who pretty tech savvy. He's the lead singer and roadie for his band. Occasionally the roar of the crowd gets to his head and he becomes someone else.
Samael Sirious (Bachelor)
Major Empirea's most infamous attorney at large. His time is worth more than the gold. Samael takes pride in his work and the money that comes from it.
